newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japanese insurers biggest yen bond buyers in March.
newsitem.headline: Japanese insurers biggest yen bond buyers in March.

text.p: Japanese insurers were the biggest buyers of yen bonds in March, the Japan Securities Dealers' Association (JSDA) said on Monday.
Life and non-life insurers' net yen bond purchases totalled 1.7143 trillion yen in March, the highest since August 1995 when they bought a record 2.3085 trillion yen worth of bonds.
The figures include Japanese government bonds, notes and Treasury bills, financing bills, corporate bonds and bank debentures, the JSDA said.
Foreign investors were the second biggest buyers of yen bonds, purchasing a net 1.4975 trillion yen in March.
